pages.text: KEYWORD FAQs OPTIONS ANSWERS Library Hours What time does the library open? Elementary School Library Regular library hours for Elementary School Library is 7:00am to 6:00pm Monday to Friday but during the full online classes, the ESD Library is closed. All library users may use the Main Library 2nd Floor in borrowing and returning of books. However, online transaction is highly recommended. High School Library Regular library hours for the Junior High School Library is 7:00am to 6:00pm Monday to Friday but during the full online classes, the JHS Library is closed. All library users may use the Main Library 2nd Floor in borrowing and returning of books. However, online transaction is highly recommended. Main Library Regular library hours of the Main Library is from 7:00am to 9:00pm Monday to Friday and 7:00am to 6:00pm during Saturdays. During full online classes, the 2nd Floor is being used for all the library transactions. Tower Library Regular library hours of the Graduate and Law School Library is from 10:00am to 9:00pm Monday to Friday and 7:30am to 9:00pm during Saturdays. During the full online classes, the Tower Library is closed. All library users may use the Main Library 2nd Floor in borrowing and returning of books. However, online transaction is highly recommended. Library location Where are the libraries located? Elementary School Library Elementary School 2nd Floor Bldg K High School Library Junior High School 1st Floor Bldg. M Main Library Main Library 1st and 2nd Floor Bldg.H Tower Library Graduate School/ Law School Library 2nd floor of the Tower Bldg., Room T-21 and 22 Library Branches How many library branches does JRU have? The JRU Library have 4 library branches: aside from the Main Library, we have Elemnetary School Library, Junior High School Library, and Tower Library which cater the Graduate and Law School students How can I contact JRU Libraries? Email JRU Library may be contacted thru support@jru.edu Landline JRU Library landline number is +632-85318031 local 15 SMS/Viber JRU Library's mobile number is 09561549981 Chat JRU Facebook Fan Page: Jose Rizal University Library or you may click this link: https://www.facebook.com/JOSE-RIZAL-UNIVERSITY-LIBRARY-373746324401/ Librarians Who are JRU Librarians? University Librarian Mrs. Rosela D. Del Mundo is the university librarian of JRU Basic Education Librarian Mr. Charliemagne Padernal is the head of the Basic Education Libraries Higher Education Librarian Mrs. Rechy Llamas is the head of the Higher Education Libraries Technical Services Librarian Mrs. Rosario Camarines is the head of the Technical Services Services How can librarians help the pupils and teachers in pupils' research work? Instructional Materials or reading materials The teacher can coordinate to the librarian on the topic they will assign to their pupils so the librarian will gather all possible reference materials that the pupils need. Research Instructions The teacher may ask the library to prepare a reading list that the students can use in their researchers Assignments The students can borrow reading materials that they need in their assignments Group Work or Projects For the SHS and Higher Education students, the library have 3 Learning Common Rooms that they can use as their area for group work or projects Services Aside from your home libraries, can other students/faculty from other division use the other library branches? Elementary School Library Yes, as long as no elementary pupils or teachers are using the ES library, and not during their library periods, vacants, recess, and library activity.

High School Library Yes, as long as no JHS students or teachers are using the JHS library, and not during their library periods, vacants, recess, and library activity. Main Library Yes, aside from the College and SHS students, the Graduate and Law School Students are allowed to use the Main Library anytime Tower Library Yes, aside from the Graduate and Law School Students, the College students are allowed to use the Tower Library from 10:00 AM to 2:00PM from Monday to Friday Library Policy Is food and drink allowed inside the library? Food and Drinks are strictly prohibited inside the library I have long breaks in between periods, is it okay if I stayed in the library while waiting? How long can I stay? As long as you need. You are free to use the library facilities while waiting. Library Policy Is it okay if I take a nap inside the library? I won't bother anyone. Unfortunately, the library does not encourage people sleeping within the premises. Library Policy I left my ID at home. Will I be allowed to stay inside the library? For security purposes, the library enforces the "no ID, no entry" policy. Students who do not have their IDs and need to use the library may get a temporary ID permit from the Student Development Office (SDO). Library Policy Why is it that only four chairs per table are allowed in the Main Library? This is done to minimize group noise in the library, as more students per table tend to result (intentionally or not) in conversations that gradually turn loud. Library Policy Since there are only four chairs per table, may we take chairs from other tables if there are five or more of us in a group? This is highly discouraged, and students will be asked to return the chairs they have moved to their proper places. In instances of five or more pupils in a group, the use of the Learning Commons on the 2nd floor is advised. Library Policy If we are not permitted to take chairs from other tables, can we just stand up and stay with our friends? We don't want to use the Learning Commons. This is not allowed, unfortunately. Everyone must be seated. You may sit at the adjacent tables if you need to be around your friends. Library Policy Can two students sit in one chair if they fit? We want to be seated together, and four chairs are not enough for our group. This is not permitted. Only one student per chair is allowed. Users are advised to use the Learning Commons on the 2nd floor of the Main Library if they come in groups of five to ten people. Library Policy May two or more users sit together by a carrel? Carrels are for single use only, and are better suited for students who prefer to study by themselves or in private. Library Policy How many people can occupy the sofas and ottomans? In order to maintain the durability of these furnitures, only 3-4 people are allowed on a sofa, and each ottoman is for a single person only. Library Policy What should I do if there are no more chairs available to sit on? You may proceed to another section of the library where seats are still available, or consider returning at a less busy time. Please do not sit on the floor. Library Policy There are no more seats available on both floors of the Main Library. What should I do? In cases like these, you may consider returning at a less busy time, or proceed to the other libraries for the meantime. Library Policy Are we allowed to play mobile games inside the library? Mobile games are discouraged, especially if they generate sounds that are distracting to other people. Since the library is a place for study, students are advised to play games in other venues. Library Policy Is it okay if I answer a phone call and video conference inside the library? In order to avoid distracting other users, users will be instructed to entertain all calls outside the library. Library Policy May I use the landlines in the library to make an outside call? This is not permitted. If the call is important, and you don't have a mobile phone, you may try calling from the Information Desk at the lobby or the Student Development Office instead.

Library Policy Can I listen to music or watch videos on my phone inside the library? This may be permitted as long as the student uses earphones or headsets. Silence must be observed above all while in the library. Library Policy My phone can't connect to the wifi. What should I do? The Main Library has four wifi networks to connect to: JRU LIB1 and JRU LIB2 for the 1st floor, and JRU LIB3 and JRU LIB4 for the 2nd floor. Select the appropriate network for the appropriate floor to get the best speeds. Log in to the network using the username and password given to you by the IT department. Library Policy Can I update, install and download applications on my phone using the school wifi, or is access blocked? Yes but not all can be opened when connected to the school's wifi networks. Library Policy What browser on my phone can I use to log in to the school wifi networks? Any browser will do. Usually, the default one will open automatically open if it detects a campus network. Library Policy Can I charge my phone in the library? You may, but keep your phone within sight and be aware of its location at all times. Library Policy Can I plug my phone to the kiosk laptops to transfer or save a file? You may, but be aware of the risks. The library will not be responsible for any damage to your phone if you do this. Library Policy Do you have whiteboard markers? We need to use the whiteboard inside the Learning Commons. Yes, we do. The student should leave his/her ID at the circulation counter in exchange for a whiteboard marker. Library Policy Do you lend speakers in the library? We need it for an activity. Unfortunately, no. The library does not store speakers for lending. Library Policy Do you lend phone chargers in the library? The library does not lend this item. Library Policy I have my own laptop and I need a charger for it. Can the library lend me one? The library does not have a universal charger that is compatible with all laptop brands and does not lend chargers separately. Library Policy May I borrow scissors, glue, tape, ruler, pencil, ballpen, puncher, eraser, calculator from the library? Possibly, though students are encouraged not to rely on the library when it comes to school items. Library Resources Is there a VGA or HDMI we can borrow at the library? The University promotes BYOD (Bring Your Own Device)but for certain cases, there are limited numbers of VGA and HDMI available n IT Office and Main Library Library Resources I need to save a file on a portable drive. Do you lend flashdrives in the library? The library does not store nor lend flashdrives. Library Resources I need an HDMI cable or an HDMI converter for my laptop. Can I borrow one from the library? The library does not have these items to lend, unfortunately. Library Attendance What is LPAM? What is LPAM LPAM is a system the library use in monitoring the number of students who use its available resources and services at a particular time. The data gathered is used for library's monthly report. How to use LPAM? LPAM can be used by tapping your ID in the LPAM machine so that your library visit can be recorded My ID cannot be read by the LPAM, what shall I do? Please report to the librarian in the counter so they may validate your ID. This is also helpful in checking your library account. Book Searching What is OPAC? What are the information that I can find in OPAC OPAC means Online Public Access Catalog. A search engine used to identify related collection and references relative to a particular subject. Users can also access online/electronic, digital resources and facilitates self renewals of not overdue books Where to access OPAC? OPAC of the JRU Library may be access through this link: library.jru.edu

Who can access it? All students, employees, and outside researchers can access it as long as there is an internet connection. Though there are some limitations on the access of the online resources for it can only be access by the bonafide students and employees of JRU
